title: Nice topper - be sure to note the back is flat.
text: Nice topper - be sure to note the back is flat.. This was a lovely tree topper, I just expected a little more. I think it's important to note that the back of this is more or less flat, so if you are thinking you are getting a starburst effect - the silver part just sorts of sticks out behind all the star. It looks nice, but i think my expectations were a bit higher.

product_metadata.title: Kurt Adler 14" 7-Point Natural Capiz Star Lighted Treetop
features: For indoor use only.60-inch lead wire
description: This 14" 7-Point Natural Capiz Star Lighted Treetop by Kurt Adler is a beautiful, classic way to accent the lighting and décor of your Christmas tree. Featuring a large 7-point star design framed by several surrounding wire ray accents, this bright star has a glittery gold-plated finish. Includes 4 spare bulbs and 2 spare fuses. Attaches to tree by a metal coil base
